mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_base_data (data_type, data_value, sort_no) VALUES (#{dataType}, #{dataValue}, #{sortNo})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_base_data WHERE data_type = #{dataType} AND data_value = #{dataValue}
mapper.select: SELECT data_value FROM t_base_data WHERE data_type = #{dataType} ORDER BY sort_no, data_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_base_data WHERE data_type = #{dataType} AND data_value = #{dataValue}
